I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store with only the afternoon shift on its appointment screen was Pine Crossing.

- **Where it came from:** Pree posted it herself in #central-team on Jun 9. The morning receiver said only the afternoon shift showed, and when a driver arrived at 7:10 they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it.
- **What's missing:** that thread gives no address or other site details for Pine Crossing. None of the shared files Pree can see list one either. I suggested she confirm the address with store ops or in Hollis's tracker before she updates the account sheet.
- **One thing to be aware of:** I also found a support ticket on onboarding six new Marrow Agrisupply stores, and Pine Crossing isn't one of them. Pree can't see that ticket, so I didn't bring it up with her.
